environment.description: Same Lambda and Step Functions workflow deployed behind an internal ALB (scheme: internal) in a private subnet. The ALB's security group references a prefix list (pl-0a8f2e19c4b7d6053) that resolves to the corporate network egress NAT ranges (10.200.0.0/16, 172.20.0.0/14) plus the HR automation system's static IPs (10.50.12.4/32, 10.50.12.5/32). The prefix list is managed by the Network Engineering team via a separate CloudFormation stack with drift detection enabled. The ALB listener has a fixed-response default action returning 403, with a forward rule conditioned on source IP matching the prefix list via security group evaluation. There is no public route to the ALB (no IGW attached to the VPC, no NAT gateway in the ALB subnet). DNS resolution for the ALB endpoint is only available via Route53 private hosted zone associated with the corporate VPC.

config.alb_subnet: private (no IGW, no NAT in subnet)
